findings: All five published captions already explicitly identify the scenes as AI-assisted historical reconstructions; do not inaccurately allege missing public-facing disclosure.

The five image-block ALT attributes omit the AI-assisted descriptor present in their captions and media-library ALT; this is accessibility/editorial parity work, not evidence of hidden synthetic imagery.
Each post src directly references the same 1672x941 original PNG stored by WordPress, with no generated subsizes; stored originals total 13,267,538 bytes, not proved network transfer.
960x540 is only a conditional derivative proposal; declared HTML width is 1024 CSS-independent pixels and true rendered CSS width/DPR/quality are unknown. Do not automatically apply downsampling.
Media attribution/creator rights are not established by the archive; do not generate or upload derivatives without rights review and staging visual QA.
Six P0 third-party image positions and Site QA #154 collector retain higher priority; historical 42 broken and 76% wire reduction are unverified.
